usage.outputShape: body.success (bool), body.html (rendered page HTML string), body.url (the scraped URL), body.type ("html")
quirks: The url query param MUST include the http:// or https:// protocol
It is a GET request with the target URL passed as a ?url= query parameter, not a JSON body
usage.guide: Send a GET to https://x402.orth.sh/context-dev/web/scrape/html with a single ?url= query param holding the full URL you want to scrape (must include http:// or https://). Pay the x402 quote (USDC on Base, ~$0.03/call). The JSON response returns the rendered page HTML at body.html, with body.success=true and body.type="html". No request body, no auth beyond the wallet payment.
